# orbstack_container (Data Source)

Read one OrbStack container by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orbstack_container" "web" {
  name = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Container name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Container id.
- `image` (String) Image reference from inspect.
- `image_id` (String) Image id from inspect.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the container is running.
